item_name: Rothco Canvas Map Case Shoulder Bag With Military Patches
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Canvas Map Case Shoulder Bag, featuring military patches, is one of the most convenient and versatile everyday carry bags you can own! This compact bag is great for storing your essential items.
description: Rothco’s Canvas Map Case Shoulder Bag, featuring military patches, is one of the most convenient and versatile everyday carry bags you can own! This compact bag has a large main compartment with a divider, and the front pocket features 2 canvas slots and 10 small elastic straps that are great for storing and organizing your essential items. Your contents won’t be going anywhere as the dual snap button flap closure securely covers the pockets and gear. In addition, a hardboard stiffener insert provides your map bag with added structure and security. The adjustable and detachable shoulder strap can fully extend to 42 inches, allowing you to effortlessly carry the tactical map case across your body or over your shoulder. Made with cotton canvas material and measuring 12" X 8 ½” X 4 ½”, the military map bag is ideal for travelers and outdoorsmen alike.
